[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec loop (string: String) (prefixes: List String) : List String :=
  match string with
  | "" => prefixes
  | _ :: tail =>
    let new_prefix := string.head :: prefixes
    loop tail new_prefix
loop string []
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation string
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  have h_length: result.length = string.length := by
    induction' string generalizing prefixes
    simp at h_length
    rename_i head tail ih
    simp at h_length
    have h_length_tail: string.tail.length = tail.length := by
      simp [string.tail]
      linarith
    simp [h_length_tail]
    simp [ih]
  simp [h_length]
  intro i
  intro h_i_lt_length
  have h_i_lt_length': i < result.length := by
    simp at h_i_lt_length
    linarith
  simp [h_i_lt_length']
  have h_prefix_eq_take: result[i]! = string.take (i + 1) := by
    induction' string generalizing prefixes
    simp at h_prefix_eq_take
    rename_i head tail ih
    simp at h_prefix_eq_take
    simp [h_prefix_eq_take]
    simp [ih]
  simp [h_prefix_eq_take]
  have h_prefix_neq_take: result[i]! ≠ string.take (i + 1) := by
    simp at h_prefix_eq_take
    simp [h_prefix_eq_take]
    simp [h_prefix_neq_take]
  contradiction
[END]
